about_the_game:
Graphics greatly influence the perception of the game. This is an important element in any game of any genre. The basic version of the game is made in a two-color style, which gives the project charm. However, some will want to try playing the game with more colorful graphics. We present to your attention a set of well-developed graphics.

Новая графика!

  • Over 30 converted buildings

  • Interface icons

  • Reworked area

  • Recycled Traps

  • New sensations

The graphics package can be turned on and off at any time in the game settings.
